name: PRENATE Enhance
indications_original:
INDICATIONS: PRENATE
  ® Enhance is a multivitamin/multimineral fatty acid dietary supplement indicated for use in improving the nutritional status of women throughout pregnancy and in the postnatal period for both lactating and nonlactating mothers. PRENATE
  ® Enhance can also be beneficial in improving the nutritional status of women prior to conception.
contraindications_original: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION: One softgel daily, or as directed by a physician.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
HOW SUPPLIED:  Bottles of 30 softgels (75854-309-30). The listed product number is not a National Drug Code. Instead, Avion Pharmaceuticals has assigned a product code formatted according to standard industry practice to meet the formatting requirements of pharmacy and healthcare insurance
computer systems.
adverseReactions_original:
CONTRAINDICATIONS: PRENATE
  ® Enhance is contraindicated in patients with a known hypersensitivity to any of the ingredients.
